text:
Priya: Team - need a fast decision on Q3 MDF reallocation. Cloud marketplace promo was delayed by their release slip and two SI onboarding timelines moved out. I propose reallocating $120k from marketplace paid activation into SI enablement and partner training to keep momentum. Can we get Partner Council sign-off by EOD Friday? @Marco please confirm runway. :eyes:

Marco: We have $200k in the Q3 MDF pool. If we shift $120k that leaves $80k for other marketplace and co-marketing plays. There are two pending partner POs that might be impacted, I'll list them after this thread.

Sam: Finance note: moving $120k is feasible if we reduce contingency from the MDF pool. Need detailed spend line items and partner IDs to update forecasts and produce the P&L adjustments.

Ava: Draft reallocation (suggested):
- SI enablement: $70,000
- Training & certs: $25,000
- MDF admin / contingency: $25,000
I'll attach the proposed training outline to the MDF ticket.

Lena: Marketing can move $20k from creative into partner enablement. That could reduce the net shift needed from MDF by the same amount. We can also scale down marketplace paid ads for the delayed promo window to $30k.

MDF Bot: Ticket created: MDF-8128 "Q3 MDF reallocation - SI priority". Status: pending_approval. Link: https://mdf.internal/tickets/MDF-8128

Priya: Also recommending a temporary scorecard multiplier change to nudge behavior this quarter. Proposed (Q3 only): marketplace_multiplier -> 1.0 (was 1.2), si_multiplier -> 1.1 (was 0.9). Effective 2026-07-15 through 2026-09-30. This is a timebox to avoid long term contract drift.

Marco: Agreed with the behavioral intent. Ops asks: ensure reporting pipeline reflects the temporary multipliers and that any payouts tied to scorecards are calculated with this override for Q3.

Sam: I'll prepare a provisional spend sheet and updated cashflow impact by tomorrow 10:00 PT. Will include partner IDs and outstanding commitments.

Nina (legal): Noted. If partners were contractually promised marketplace placement we may need short addenda or an agreed alternative benefit. Please send affected partner list and the proposed communications. I can review the language within 48 hours.

Ava: Quick impact estimate: $70k enablement + 1.1 SI multiplier -> projected $420k qualified pipeline over 6 months (model in #partnerships-data). Assumes ~35% conversion into pipeline from enabled SIs. Will provide partner-level uplift matrix.

Priya: Decision checklist to execute:
- Finance sign-off for reallocation (Sam)
- Legal sign-off on partner comms (Nina)
- Partner Council informal vote (channel reactions ok)
If we have all by Fri 17:00 PT I will confirm and instruct MDF Bot to issue POs and update the portal.

Reactions / votes: Marco: :thumbsup:, Sam: :thumbsup: (conditional), Lena: :thumbsup:, Nina: waiting on draft, Ava: :thumbsup:.

Marco: I'll flag the two pending partner POs in ops sync and suggest priority processing for them if needed.

Sam: Will attach partner IDs and the spend sheet here tomorrow.

Ava: Uploading training curriculum + enablement schedule to MDF-8128 now and cross-posting to #partner-enablement.

Priya: Thanks all. If no blockers by Fri 17:00 PT I will publish the partner comms template and the scorecard change PR. :pray:

MDF Bot: Reminder scheduled for 2026-07-17 09:00 PT for approval follow-up (MDF-8128).
